section.workspaceRoots.title: Workspaces
section.workspaceRoots.subtitle: Roots beyond the session directory that @ completion and the file panel may open
field.workspaceRoots.label: Extra workspace roots
field.workspaceRoots.placeholder: One absolute path per line; semicolons also work
field.workspaceRoots.help: The session directory is always the first root and does not need to be listed. Entries that do not exist or are not directories are dropped on save with a notice. The next @ uses the new roots.
save.ok: Saved; the next @ uses the new roots
save.dropped: Saved; these entries do not exist or are not directories and were dropped: {entries}
